description: A ground-level photograph depicting rows of young grapevines on a gently sloping terrain, extending into the mid-ground. The vines are small, deciduous plants with green leaves, planted in neat parallel lines. The soil between the rows is dry and light brown, with sparse dry vegetation and some fallen leaves. In the background, a hillside rises, covered with a mix of green trees and scrubland under a blue sky with some white clouds. This photograph, credited to M. Palacios, shows vineyards in the Duero Valley, Central Spain, which are typically classified as permanent crops in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) nomenclature guidelines.
